lines.text: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 at $8/$40; AA ranks it #1 on Intelligence Index v5 at 65
Anthropic launches IPO roadshow: 825M shares at $70 to $78 on Nasdaq under ticker ANT
Google adds TPU 8tx for confidential inference and dual-chip TPU 8i Max for long context

feed.headline: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2; AA puts Fable 5.2 #1 at 65
feed.why: Same model, two access levels. Fable is $8/$40, 20% below 5.1. AA: 65 vs Gemini 4 Carbon High 60; Epoch ECI also tops at 174.

feed.headline: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 a share, Nasdaq ticker ANT
feed.why: 825M Class A shares, 801M of them new from Anthropic. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead. Pricing date not on Anthropic's page.

feed.headline: Google adds TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max to its eighth-gen TPU lineup
feed.why: 8tx keeps data and weights protected in use, up to 2x lower latency than 8t. 8i Max doubles 8i compute, SRAM and HBM bandwidth.

feed.headline: Meta's Muse Ember scores 36 on AA Intelligence Index at $0.14 per task
feed.why: Matches Claude Haiku 5.5 (max) at about a third of the cost per task, per AA. $0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens on Meta's API.

feed.headline: Meituan posts LongCat-2.5 weights under MIT on Hugging Face
feed.why: About 1.6T total, 48B active per Meituan. Meituan's own benches put it near older frontier models. No AA Index score yet.

feed.headline: OpenAI details Control Room, a system to stop research model workloads fast
feed.why: OpenAI says it halts model output within 35 seconds of a stop decision and fails closed if the service goes down.

feed.headline: Australia to legislate mandatory frontier AI safety rules and a new regulator
feed.why: Six duties incl. independent model evals and rapid incident reports, with significant penalties. Bill details still to come.

feed.headline: FT: Nvidia tells cloud partners at least 51% of services must go to non-Chinese firms
feed.why: Verbal rule for new deals, per FT via Tom's Hardware. Nvidia has not confirmed. Aimed at overseas GPU rentals by Chinese labs.

feed.headline: Fireworks AI says attackers reached some customers' datasets and incomplete model weights
feed.why: Update to its October incident. Billing data also hit. No impact found on inference, which is zero data retention by default.
